fusions.name: Trodden Path
fusions.desc: Stamps the ground, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have walked since you last used it (max 30%). Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Creeping Runner
fusions.desc: Sends a runner along the ground to one enemy up to 7 tiles away, dealing 28 damage that ignores armour and grows to as much as 2 times its damage at maximum range.

fusions.name: Wayside Plantain
fusions.desc: Chews a roadside leaf that restores 12 health and raises your stamina recovery by 40% for 20 seconds.

fusions.name: Mile Grass
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you walk, you regain 2 health a second for 3 seconds. Once every 5 seconds.
